description.value: A cross-sectional voxel-based morphometry study compared gray-matter volume between betel quid chewers and controls and examined associations between regional GMV and betel quid dependence and chewing behavior.

spans.text: The present study aimed to investigate the brain structure basis of BQ chewing in Hunan province of China.

description.value: Cross-sectional observational study of 25 betel quid chewers and 25 controls recruited in Hunan, China; participants underwent behavioral interview and one structural MRI scan.

value: After controlling for education, BQ chewers showed reduced gray-matter volume in bilateral VMPFC, bilateral DLPFC extending to IFG and insula, and left OFC compared with controls; no regions showed higher GMV in BQ chewers.

description.value: VBM preprocessing included brain extraction, tissue segmentation, linear and non-linear registration to standard space, study-specific template creation, and smoothing.

spans.text: Brains were extracted using BET ( 28 ) and segmented into gray matter, white matter and CSF using FAST4 ( 29 ). Two steps of registration (linear and non-linear) were performed to register the gray-matter partial volume images to the standard space (MNI152). A study specific template was created by averaging all normalized images. Last, the resulting GMV images were smoothed with an isotropic Gaussian kernel (3 mm).
